versions.changelog:
Initial release of secrets-vault: secure sensitive data management.

- AES-256-GCM encrypted vault for API keys, credentials, and certificates
- Master password protection with PBKDF2-hardening (600k iterations)
- Auto-inject secrets as environment variables or into .env files
- Secure, time-limited one-time sharing of secrets
- Built-in password auditing (strength, breach detection, duplicates)
- Cross-device sync support for encrypted vault file
- CLI scripts for vault management, environment handling, sharing, and auditing
